name: glass-carousel
summary: Swipe cards through a liquid-glass lens; tap one to lift it while the rest fall away.
props: One card each; the carousel loops.
Card content (snapshotted). Call onLoad when its images have loaded.
Layer under the content, blurred toward the bottom.
Full-size layer behind the carousel; cross-fades between items as you scroll.
What screen readers say for a card.
Card height; shrinks to fit short screens.
Controlled centre card; turns the shortest way round.
Fires when the centre card changes.
The centre card opened or closed.
Change it to snapshot every card again.
Drawn above the carousel: a header, buttons.
Root style; give it a screen or a tall card.
behavior: Drag or flick sideways; a flick always moves at least one card. Tap a side card to turn to it and open it, tap the centre card to open it, tap anywhere to close.
A Skia shader bends the cards at the screen edges, magnified inward with a red/green/blue split. Once the carousel settles, the centre card is drawn sharp.
Each card's content is snapshotted into an image, so keep it static. Call onLoad from your images so the card is captured again once they load; change extraData to capture every card again.
renderBackdrop draws under the content and is blurred in toward the bottom of the card, so text there stays readable over a photo.
One adjustable element ('Sunrise Yoga, 1 of 4'): swipe up or down to change cards; activate and escape open and close.
Scrolling settles faster and opening jumps straight to its end state.
No view snapshots there: the cards scroll and open the same way as live views, without the lens.
